intro_txt: Welcome to episode one of our spot the difference series! Look closely at the two pictures, and find every difference before the timer runs out. Don't forget to like and subscribe! Let's go!
outro_txt: Great job! Thanks for playing. Like and subscribe for more puzzles!
timesup: Time's up! Here are the differences.

pictures.name: Sunny Park

diffs.text: The flower at the bottom is orange on the left, but brown on the right
There is a sun on the left, but it is missing on the right
The cloud in the top left is white on the left, but yellow on the right
No mushroom in the middle on the left, but a red mushroom on the right
The tree in the middle is green on the left, but brown on the right

cd_lines: Picture one. How many differences can you spot? Time starts now!

pictures.name: Beach Day

diffs.text: There is a fish on the left, but it is missing on the right
The boat on the right side is small on the left, but big on the right
No apple in the middle on the left, but a green apple on the right
There is a sun on the left, but it is missing on the right

cd_lines: Picture two. How many differences can you spot? Time starts now!

pictures.name: Outer Space

diffs.text: The planet at the top is orange on the left, but red on the right
There is a star in the bottom left on the left, but it is missing on the right
The star in the top right is big on the left, but small on the right
The rocket at the bottom is big on the left, but small on the right
The star at the bottom is yellow on the left, but brown on the right

cd_lines: Picture three. How many differences can you spot? Time starts now!

pictures.name: Busy City

diffs.text: There is a sun on the left, but it is missing on the right
The tree is green on the left, but orange on the right
There is a car in the bottom left on the left, but it is missing on the right
No bubble at the bottom on the left, but a blue bubble on the right
The house on the left side is yellow on the left, but pink on the right

cd_lines: Picture four. How many differences can you spot? Time starts now!

middle.say: Enjoying the puzzles? Hit like and subscribe!

notes: تفاوت ساخته‌شده «The umbrella in the bottom right is small on the left, but big on the right» در بررسی عددی قابل تشخیص نبود و حذف شد
